description: SEC fails-to-deliver: one row per CUSIP per settlement date. quantity_fails is SEC's total balance of undelivered shares as of that date, not one trade. fail_value = quantity_fails x price (null: no price). SEC posts each half-month ~2-3 weeks after it ends. Each query reads the newest max(500, 4 x limit) rows by sort_by, then filters. since/until: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on settlement_date (date sort only). More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_sec_fails_to_deliver
name: get_sec_fails_to_deliver
